scientific_integrity: Exact algebraic proof with sampled reproducibility checks; the earliest day-verified cited preprint is the 2004-11-30 arXiv submission; model antecedents are historically earlier.
scientific_limitations: Only the prime-period-two spectrum for a>=0 and 0<b<1 is classified. Endpoint nonlinear behavior, other periods, coexistence and global basins are not determined. Earlier exact equivalent literature is a residual originality risk.
title: Complete prime-period-two spectrum and the sharp sink boundary of the Duffing map
